run_provenance: Original make verify run on frozen clean C10, with clean start and end recorded by the host. These two files are archived byte-for-byte; earlier C10 targeted logs ran before commit and remain separately identified.

application_tests.skip_reason: The application reporter records one skip without naming it at the counter transition; do not conflate that count with the separate nightly resource benchmark gate.

signature_checks.basis: tools/verify_macos_app.sh uses set -euo pipefail and requires codesign --verify --deep --strict before successful completion; successful codesign verification is silent. This does not infer notarization or certificate class.

counting_policy: Counts belong to separate invocations; do not add precommit selections, historical C9/C8 counts, or native subtests to claim a unique PRD scenario total.
evidence_boundaries: All four native drivers logged Failed to foreground app; open returned 1 and subsequently passed their actual driver assertions. These runs do not prove foreground physical input or normal UI visual acceptance.
